newsitem.title: USA: Paragon Trade sees full year EPS $1.00-$1.25.
newsitem.headline: Paragon Trade sees full year EPS $1.00-$1.25.

text.p: Paragon Trade Brands Inc said Friday it expects 1997 full year earnings of $1.00 to $1.25 per share.
The company said it expects baby diaper sales to strengthen in the second half of the year, driven by its new product roll out.
However, it said additional promotional spending, rising pulp costs and the delay of its feminine care sales build-up will impact operating performance during the remainder of the year.
The company said it will continue to focus on building the feminine care business, and to manage costs and improve products in the diaper business.
It said it believes these efforts will position the it for improved 1998 earnings.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.22 compared to $0.44 for the same period a year ago.
Baby diaper earnings were $0.41 per share compared to $0.71 per share.
In its feminine care business, the company said it lowered start-up losses from $0.28 per share in the first quarter of 1997 to $0.17 per share for the second quarter.
